subcategory_text: Assess the risk of each vulnerability in the context of the deployed software and prioritise remediation accordingly. Apply SLAs based on severity (e.g., critical within 24h, high within 7 days, medium within 30 days).
implementation_examples: Apply mitigations (workarounds) when immediate patching is infeasible
assessment_objectives: Determine whether vulnerabilities are prioritised using risk-based SLAs.
Determine whether mitigations are applied when patches are deferred.
